fields.summary_ko.0: Advanced Micro Devices, Inc. (AMD) supplies semiconductor products including AI accelerators, GPUs, processors, and FPGAs internationally across three segments: Data Center, Client and Gaming, and Embedded.
fields.summary_ko.1: Through brand portfolio including AMD Ryzen, EPYC, Radeon, and Instinct, provides solutions to cloud service providers, OEMs, and system integrators.
